content: {"kind":"plan","text":"这组只在工位用一把椅子完成，重点拉伸髋前侧，再用骨盆画圈、髋内外旋活动和臀部外侧拉伸收尾，共约 10 分钟。难度按入门 1 安排，全程不要憋气，慢慢呼吸。","plan":{"schemaVersion":1,"source":"ai","title":"工位开髋·髋前侧","summary":"用一把椅子，10 分钟放松僵硬的髋前侧并活动髋关节。","goal":"mobility","scene":"office","equipment":["chair"],"level":1,"targetMinutes":10,"avoid":[],"blocks":[{"id":"b1","name":"热身","type":"warmup","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"n-pelvis-circle","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"h-hip-gate","mode":"reps","sets":1,"reps":6,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10}]},{"id":"b2","name":"主训练","type":"main","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"o-stand-lunge","mode":"time","sets":2,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"n-chair-wiper","mode":"reps","sets":1,"reps":6,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"o-stand-crossreach","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10}]},{"id":"b3","name":"放松","type":"cooldown","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"o-seated-fig4","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"n-wide-fold","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10}]}],"notes":["办公室默认只有椅子和墙，本计划只用到椅子，无需自带器械","时长按 10 分钟估算；若时间充裕，扶椅弓步屈髋拉伸可每侧多做一组"],"safetyNotes":["全程在不痛的范围内缓慢进行，不适加重就停下来休息","拉伸时保持自然呼吸，不要塌腰或憋气"]}}
